_comment: Partner links rendered by build-parks.mjs. Each slot: `url` is the untracked fallback; set `trackedUrl` once a program approves you and it takes over automatically. Placeholders: {q} = '<Park> National Park, <State>' | {park} = park name | {state} | {city} (near pages) | {lat} {lng}. `contexts` controls where it shows: park (park pages), near (city pages). `requires` = 'camping' hides the slot on parks with no campgrounds. Links render rel=sponsored and fire a GA4 'affiliate_click' event.

_apply.stay: Booking.com Affiliate Partner Programme (or Expedia Group via Partnerize). Paste the tracked deep link as trackedUrl with {q} kept in it.
_apply.camp: Hipcamp affiliate runs on Impact.com; The Dyrt is the alternative.
_apply.pass: REI sells the America the Beautiful pass; REI's affiliate program is on AvantLink. USGS store has no program.
_apply.car: Expedia/Discover Cars/RentalCars via Partnerize or TravelPayouts.
_apply.guide: Already tracked: Amazon Associates tag parkatlas-20 (same as /gear).

disclosure: Some links on this page are affiliate links. If you book or buy through them, ParkAtlas may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. It helps keep the app free of ads.
